comment: Name-filter exceptions for fetch_all_thai_data.py. The core search only keeps venues whose name contains 'thai'; genuine Thai venues without it are allowlisted here by FSA ID, each verified before entry. blocklist = known non-Thai false positives that must never re-enter the data (e.g. Chai/I-Chai venues that substring-match 'Thai' searches).
